message.body: HQ closed HQ.ticket.fleet-locks-have-no-history and shipped scripts/drain_log.py in the brain repo (append-only writer for planning/roadmaps/<roadmap>/drain-log.jsonl, gated as drain-log-tests). The CALL SITE is unwired and is yours: /orchestration-commander step 6 must invoke it alongside the heartbeat stamp -- python3 <brain-root>/scripts/drain_log.py record --roadmap <slug> --lock-dir <lock_dir> --drained N --routed N --completed N --manifest-paths N --orphan-inbox N --orphan-processing N --orphan-receipts N. HQ did not edit base-template/.claude/commands/orchestration-commander.md because base-template-4c held an exclusive lease and rule 6 bars cross-lane edits. Run drain_log.py --help for the flags. NOTE ON DISCOVERY: the durable entry lives in HQ's planning/state.json, and mev carryover --repo base-template keys on the FILE an entry lives in, not scope.repo, so this finding is invisible to your own carryover sweep -- that blind spot is why this ping exists.
